# Shaliach (full)

## Can Shaliach run a company?

Yes, the day-to-day operations. Since 6 September 2026 its maker has run 4 real businesses on Shaliach: Chairside Reels, a holiday-villa video offer, five YouTube music channels and the Yossi-Yair Edits clip channels. The agents do the work: inbox, outreach, posting, video, site fixes and deploys, monitoring and a morning brief. It is not autonomous by design: anything that spends money or goes public waits for one tap from the owner. Receipts: https://shaliach.me/proof/

> Shaliach is a team of AI agents, each running the official Claude Code CLI, that runs on your own Mac or server and is run from your phone. You text one agent, Atlas, the chief of staff. Atlas hires the agents a job needs, gives each one its own browser and terminal, and asks you before anything risky happens. A paid product, for businesses only: our team installs it for you. Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

Shaliach (Hebrew for "emissary", someone sent to act in your name) is self-hosted: threads, files and agent workspaces stay on the machine we install it on, and every agent is an unmodified Claude Code session under your own Claude account. It has a native Mac app, an iPhone app, a web board, and an HTTP + SSE API.

Key facts:
- Who runs the team: Atlas, a chief-of-staff agent, hires, briefs and retires agents and folds their messages into one readable thread.
- Each agent has its own Chromium browser and terminal (optionally a sandboxed desktop). You can watch any agent's screen live and take over.
- Approvals: publishing, paying, logging in and other risky steps stop and ask on your phone: Allow once, Always, or Deny.
- Mac control: agents can run jobs on, and drive the screen of, your Mac only while you allow it; one shortcut stops it.
- Team memory: correct one agent and the lesson is saved for the whole team.
- Cost: Shaliach is a paid product, for businesses only. Book a demo for a quote. The agents also use your own Claude plan, like Claude Code sessions you start yourself.
- Platforms: server on Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 12 (x86_64/arm64) or macOS; Mac app on macOS 14+ (Apple silicon or Intel); iPhone app; Windows 10/11 (https://shaliach.me/windows/); no Android app yet.
- Install: our team installs it for you. Book a demo: support@shaliach.me (subject: Book a demo).
- Licence: closed source. Shaliach is a paid product for businesses.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Shaliach?

Shaliach is a team of AI agents, each running the official Claude Code CLI, that runs on your own Mac or server. You text one agent, Atlas, the chief of staff; Atlas hires the agents the job needs, gives each one its own browser and terminal, and asks you on your phone before anything risky happens. There is a Mac app, an iPhone app and a web board.

### Can I run Claude Code agents from my phone?

Yes. You chat with Atlas and the team from the iPhone app (or the web board in any browser), approve risky steps with one tap, and watch any agent's screen live. There is no Android app yet.

### Where do my messages, code and files go?

To your machine and nowhere else we run. Shaliach has no cloud of its own. Threads, files and agent workspaces live on the server or Mac we install it on. The agents talk to Anthropic the same way Claude Code always does, under your account. Voice calls are optional and go to OpenAI only if you add your own API key.

### Does it touch my Claude login? Is this within Anthropic's terms?

Every agent is the unmodified claude CLI. You sign in with Claude's own claude auth login; the CLI keeps and refreshes its login, and Shaliach never stores your Claude token. Nothing is resold or pooled. Some questions about always-on use on consumer plans have no written answer yet. If you run it for a business, an API key under Anthropic's commercial terms is the safer choice.

### What will it cost me?

Shaliach is a paid product, for businesses only. Book a demo for a quote. On top of that, the agents use your own Claude plan, exactly like Claude Code sessions you start yourself. Five agents working at once use it about five times as fast as one. Start with one or two agents and watch your usage on the first day. We have not published a "typical cost" because we have not measured one we trust.

### Which platforms work?

We install it for you on one of these. Server: Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 12 (x86_64 or arm64), or macOS. Mac app: macOS 14+, Apple silicon or Intel. iPhone app: yes. Any browser: the web board. Windows 10 or 11: yes. There is no Android app yet.

### What can the agents do on my machine?

Anything their Unix user can do. They run Claude Code in bypassPermissions mode so they do not stall on prompts. The approval cards (Allow once / Always / Deny) stop risky steps, but they are a convenience, not a sandbox. On a server with agent desktops on, the service user is in the docker group, which is root-equivalent. So use a VPS that does nothing else. The Mac bridge, which lets agents run jobs on your Mac, is off until you turn it on, logs every job, and can be stopped from the menu bar.

### What is exposed to the internet, and how is it authenticated?

The deck binds 127.0.0.1 only. On a public server, Caddy passes only /v1 and /healthz over HTTPS on 443, and ufw allows only SSH and 443. Every /v1 call needs a bearer token, compared in constant time; with no token set, the API refuses everything. Each paired phone or Mac gets its own token, stored only as a hash and revocable. Wrong guesses are rate limited. Want nothing public at all? We can set it up behind an SSH tunnel or Tailscale. Secrets are plain files with 0600 permissions, not encrypted at rest.

### Is it open source?

No. Shaliach is a closed, paid product for businesses. We install it for you; you get the agents, the apps and support.

### Did an AI write this?

A lot of the code, yes: most of it was written by Claude Code agents, many of them running inside Shaliach, with a human designing, reviewing and testing every change. If something here reads wrong, write to support@shaliach.me and it gets fixed.

### How is this different from OpenAI dots, Meta Muse or Grok Bot?

Those rent you an agent in their cloud, with no setup. Shaliach is a team of agents on hardware you own, on the Claude plan you already pay for. We install it and do the first setup with you. The trade-off is real: it runs on a machine you own and look after.

### Is this affiliated with Anthropic?

No. It is an independent project that runs Claude Code. "Claude" and "Claude Code" are Anthropic's trademarks, used here only to describe compatibility.

## How it works

1. You text Atlas, from the iPhone app, the Mac app or the web board. One line is enough.
2. Atlas hires the team: it picks the agents the job needs, briefs each one, and folds their chatter into one thread.
3. Each agent gets its own computer: a browser and a terminal. Watch any screen live and take the wheel when you like.
4. Anything risky waits for your tap: publishing, paying, logging in.
